name: tape
title: Tape
description: A strip of masking, washi, kraft or cellophane tape, drawn: translucent, with slit lines along its edges, crinkles and torn or pinked ends. Stick it across a corner, use it as a label, or let Paper place it for you.

a11y: Tape is decoration: aria-hidden, focusable=false, pointer-events: none. Never put the only copy of information on it; a label written on tape is real text next to (not inside) the svg.
Tape keeps its colors in Windows high contrast (it is an intrinsic ink kind).
Its tilt collapses to zero in calm density.

import { Tape } from "@/components/ui/tape"
